notes.title: v1.1.0 for Demo
notes.content:
Note
Update the game Minor ver. You can't play game with user using 1.0.x.

v1.1.0
I have relaxed the custom options (e.g., to make the game shorter or longer so that it can be played by 2 players) and enhanced the custom editing functionality. I also fixed a bug that sometimes prevented games from starting if there were more than 4 people in a custom game.
While the build has passed review, I'm planning for an official release around July 20th. I'm currently working on improving performance for macOS and fixing a bug that occasionally causes synchronization issues.
You can play together with Android and iOS users, so please give it a try! Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!
Website
https://ponolf.skeyll.net/


What's new
Fix
Fix a bug that sometimes Host can't start the match on Custom for 4 or more players.
Reset scrollbars to the top of each panel at Start.

Add
Add a button to initialize Custom options.

Change
Relax the options for Custom Match.
Allow modifying Custom options through InputField.
Trim spaces from created questions.
Changed matchmaking conditions for Custom Match to allow matches with users using the full package version.
